note: The Banque centrale du Luxembourg: there is no register or central database for consumer credit in Luxembourg, and the central bank keeps no national credit register.

sources.title: Banque centrale du Luxembourg, Can I contact the BCL to obtain a copy of my data held in the central register of consumer credit?
sources.said: In Luxembourg, there is no register or central database for consumer credit. ... At present, these tasks do not include the management of a national credit register.
